records.title: DARWIN: Evolving Jailbreak Adversary and Guardrail for LLM Safety Evaluation and Protection
records.reason: DARWIN evaluates jailbreak robustness and attack strategies; it is security evaluation, not an inference-cost reduction.

records.title: OvisOCR2 Technical Report
records.reason: OvisOCR2 proposes a compact 0.8B document-understanding/parser model and one-pass pipeline, suggesting deployment potential, but the primary full text provides no measured inference latency, throughput, memory, or FLOP reduction.

records.title: Self in Space: Benchmarking Self-Awareness and Spatial Cognition in UAV Embodied Intelligence
records.reason: The paper contributes a UAV spatial reasoning benchmark and task suite; it does not introduce an LLM-serving or inference optimization technique.

records.title: LongMedBench: Benchmarking Medical Agents for Long-Horizon Clinical Decision-Making
records.reason: LongMedBench evaluates long-context medical reasoning; it is a benchmark/dataset contribution and does not establish an inference optimization.

records.title: SWE-Review: Closing the Loop on Issue Resolution with Agentic Code Review
records.reason: SWE-Review evaluates agentic code review tasks and reviewer behavior; it does not propose a concrete model-inference or serving optimization.
